purpose: Independent prospective validation of a frozen training-target screening candidate, not model final evaluation

synthetic.use_rule: Do not run or inspect candidate responses on this validation set until candidate code/configuration hashes have been frozen. Do not tune on results and still call this set independent validation.

real_target_sampling.pool: Original V1 train.zh rows with teacher_accepted exactly true
strata: presence of any frozen old-P0 flag
real_target_sampling.allocation: Within each source give one slot to every nonempty length-by-oldflag stratum, then repeatedly give one additional slot to strata ordered by decreasing eligible size and lexical tie-break until source quota 10; never exceed stratum capacity. Sample deterministically from ID-sorted strata using random.Random(seed).
real_target_sampling.selection_reads: Metadata and source/target bytes for hashing only; semantic source/target inspection occurs only after manifest and packet freeze. No new screening results are read.
real_target_sampling.same_training_group_exclusion: Not required: this audits the original training-target pool and does not define an independent model final test.

sequence: Read source and list its explicit facts/relations/qualifiers before judging target.
Compare the target to source meaning; do not use old flags as correctness labels.
Record definite source inconsistency, source information missing and any unjudgeable component separately; categories may overlap.
Assess old rule flags separately only after source-target judgment.
source_first_review.unjudgeable: Do not invent missing source meaning or adjudicate imaging truth. Unclear terminology, ambiguous dates and source contradictions remain unresolved.
source_first_review.required_information_missing_scope: Includes explicit relations, qualifiers, anatomical precision and acquisition metadata; does not imply clinically necessary information adjudicated by a clinician.

constraints: No GPU, SSH, model execution or new final model-test selection in this preparation.
Do not modify existing V1/V2/V3 data, old synthetic 60 pairs or the existing old18 review.
Real source text and synthetic target text derived from real reports remain ignored under data/p1/quality-validation-20261117.
The stratified sample is not a population estimate or independent clinical gold standard.
